audience: IT admins and DevOps teams who run their network with Tailscale

useCases.title: Find devices that have not been seen lately
useCases.text: The AI lists the devices in the tailnet with OS, addresses, tags and last seen time. It picks out stale ones and groups them by OS or tag.

useCases.title: Check users, keys and their expiry
useCases.text: The AI lists the users and their roles, and the auth keys and API tokens with expiry. You see which keys end soon.

useCases.title: Review ACLs, DNS and tailnet settings
useCases.text: The AI reads the policy file, DNS nameservers, split DNS and tailnet settings, and explains them.

useCases.title: Rename or tag devices, change approval or subnet routes
useCases.text: The AI renames a device, replaces its ACL tags, authorizes or de-authorizes it, or changes the enabled subnet routes of a device.

useCases.title: Respond to a lost device or leaked key
useCases.text: The AI expires a device's node key to force sign-in again, deletes a device, or revokes an auth key. It can also create a new auth key.
